title.white:
kisi bhi bank ka card
kaise chalta hai?

style_prefix: 3D papercraft stop-motion diorama, vertical 9:16, handcrafted cardboard and coloured paper textures, warm cinematic lighting, soft depth of field, cosy. Mascot: a cute cartoon debit card character (navy blue card with gold and light-blue diagonal stripes, gold chip, big googly eyes, smile, white cartoon gloves, thin legs, yellow shoes). Indian setting. Leave the bottom third simple for captions. SCENE:

shots.caption: Card [y]ek bank[/y] ka, ATM [y]doosre bank[/y] ka… phir bhi paisa nikal aata hai. [r]Kaise?[/r]
shots.image: Wide establishing shot of a papercraft Indian city street at night, a cardboard bank building with columns and a sign that says BANK, next to it a small street ATM kiosk with a glowing orange sign that says ATM, warm lit windows, paper buildings around. No mascot.
shots.motion: Slow cinematic push-in towards the glowing ATM kiosk, windows flicker softly.

shots.caption: Sach yeh hai: ATM ko aapke account ka [r]kuch pata hi nahi[/r] hota!
shots.image: The mascot stands in front of an Indian street ATM kiosk made of cardboard, orange header sign that says ATM, evening light.
shots.motion: Mascot shrugs with both gloves raised, slow push-in.

shots.caption: [y]Step #1:[/y] card daala, PIN dabaya… PIN turant [r]encrypt[/r] ho jaata hai
shots.image: Close-up of a papercraft ATM keypad with chunky paper buttons, the mascot's white glove pressing a button, the card mascot half inserted into the card slot, smiling.
shots.motion: Glove presses keys one by one, camera slowly pushes in.

shots.caption: Matlab ATM wale bank ko bhi aapka PIN [r]dikhta hi nahi[/r]
shots.image: A sealed paper envelope locked with a big shiny gold paper padlock, floating in front of a papercraft ATM screen, four asterisk symbols on the envelope.
shots.motion: Padlock clicks shut, camera zooms into the padlock until it fills the frame.

shots.caption: [y]Step #2:[/y] request jaati hai [y]NPCI ke NFS switch[/y] pe… India ka [r]ATM exchange[/r]
shots.image: A big papercraft telephone-exchange building in the centre with a sign that says NFS, paper wires and string connecting it to many small colourful cardboard bank buildings around it, glowing paper signals travelling along the wires.
shots.motion: Slow pan across the network, glowing signals race along the wires to the centre.

shots.caption: Card ke [y]pehle kuch digits[/y] se pata chalta hai… card [r]kaunse bank[/r] ka hai
shots.image: The mascot holding a big paper magnifying glass over its own card number, the first digits glowing gold, paper office background.
shots.motion: Mascot moves the magnifying glass, digits light up, slow push-in.

shots.caption: [y]Step #3:[/y] aapka bank check karta hai: [r]PIN sahi? Balance hai? Limit bachi hai?[/r]
shots.image: Papercraft bank office, a paper banker in a suit at a desk ticking a checklist on a clipboard with three green checkmarks, the mascot watching nervously from the side.
shots.motion: Banker ticks the three boxes one after another, gentle pan.

shots.caption: Sab theek? Account se paisa kata… aur reply gaya: [r]APPROVED![/r]
shots.image: A paper banker's hand slamming a big red rubber stamp on a paper form that says APPROVED in green, the mascot cheering in the background.
shots.motion: Stamp slams down, little paper confetti pops, camera zooms into the APPROVED stamp.

shots.caption: [y]Step #4:[/y] ATM se cash bahar… aur yeh sab [r]kuch seconds[/r] mein!
shots.image: A papercraft ATM dispensing a stack of paper Indian rupee notes, the mascot happily catching the notes with both gloves, warm light.
shots.motion: Notes slide out of the slot, mascot catches them and jumps, push-in.

shots.caption: Par ATM [r]doosre bank[/r] ka tha… toh aapka bank usse [y]₹19 fee[/y] deta hai
shots.image: The mascot carrying a giant shiny gold paper rupee coin from one cardboard bank building on the left to another cardboard bank building on the right, papercraft street.
shots.motion: Mascot walks left to right carrying the coin, camera pans with it.

shots.caption: Isiliye doosre bank ke ATM pe free limit: [y]metro mein 3[/y], [y]baaki shehron mein 5[/y]
shots.image: A papercraft desk calendar with the numbers 3 and 5 circled in red paper, the mascot pointing at it with a glove, paper office desk.
shots.motion: Mascot taps the calendar, camera zooms into the calendar page.

shots.caption: Uske baad har transaction pe [r]₹23 tak charge[/r] [y]+ GST[/y]
shots.image: The mascot looking shocked, eyes wide, holding a long paper receipt that curls to the floor, red paper rupee symbols floating around.
shots.motion: Receipt unrolls longer and longer, mascot's eyes widen, push-in.

shots.caption: Paisa kata, cash nahi aaya? [y]5 din[/y] mein wapas… warna bank deta hai [r]₹100 roz[/r]
shots.image: A papercraft ATM with a red X error on its screen and an empty cash slot, the worried mascot next to it, then a paper banker handing the mascot a paper rupee note with an apologetic smile.
shots.motion: Screen blinks red, banker hands over a note, mascot relaxes, slow push-in.

shots.caption: Ab pata hai ATM ke andar kya chalta hai! [y]Follow[/y] karo, agla: [r]UPI kaise kaam karta hai?[/r]
shots.image: The mascot wearing cool black paper sunglasses, one glove adjusting them, confident pose on a wooden papercraft desk with pencils and books.
shots.motion: Mascot slides on sunglasses and gives a thumbs up, slow push-in.
